bio: Senhachi is a master of the gravitational arts, able to make people as heavy as a mountain or as light as a feather; it's as easy as swishing his finger. Surely with that power, he'd be the head of a Dynasty? Nope. Turns out, Senhachi prefers a quiet cup of tea and a meditate. It's much more peaceful.
